package.name: safety_island_msgs
package.description: Messages authored by the Autoware Safety Island actuation module. ApprovedRequest is the single supervised actuator-facing output of the Safety Island (see the vp_si_control_contract design doc and Safety Island issues #62/#63/#64/#65): its source of truth today is the SI-side IDL (actuation_module/src/autoware/autoware_msgs/msg/ApprovedRequest.idl); this ROS-side package mirrors it so Humble readers and the future CARLA actuator can consume the topic.
